title.hr: Opseg i površina na kvadratnoj mreži
title.en: Perimeter and area on squared paper

concept.hr: Opseg je duljina ruba, površina broj jediničnih kvadrata: nisu ista stvar
concept.en: Perimeter is the edge's length, area the number of unit squares: not the same

summary.hr: Oboji kvadrate i gledaj opseg i površinu, složi istih 12 kvadrata u sve pravokutnike i usporedi ih, obiđi rub i prebroji mu stranice.
summary.en: Colour squares and watch perimeter and area, lay the same 12 squares as every rectangle and compare, walk round the edge and count its sides.

title.en: 12 squares: the same area, different perimeters

concept.hr: Pravokutnici 1 × 12, 2 × 6 i 3 × 4: P = 12 cm², a o = 26, 16 i 14 cm
concept.en: Rectangles 1 × 12, 2 × 6 and 3 × 4: area 12 cm², perimeters 26, 16 and 14 cm

title.en: Walk round the edge: the perimeter

concept.hr: Opseg je duljina ruba: brojimo stranice kvadrata na rubu
concept.en: The perimeter is the edge's length: count the sides of squares on it
